prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-resolution raster concept contact sheet, six IAP modal popups for the mobile game Racing Manager.
Primary request: Redesign the six inconsistent popups in reference 1 into one beautifully consistent Soft Miniature UI family with stronger visual grouping. User authorizes changing their layouts. Produce ONE large 3-column by 2-row contact sheet, preferably 3072x3072 or larger, with six equally sized tall cards, generous gutters and aligned edges. This is a design concept, not an HTML page. No device frames, no background game screen, no annotation paragraphs.
Input images: reference 1 = original six popup screenshots, source contents and driver identity; reference 2 = approved starter pack Soft Miniature style; reference 3 = approved weekly pack style; reference 4 = approved no ads bundle style.
Style/medium: polished cute miniature 3D game UI, cream ceramic-like rounded panels, restrained blue racing title ribbon, soft bevels, warm shadows, saturated purple gems, orange purchase button, navy rounded typography. Follow approved references closely but simplify ornament to improve clarity. No chrome metallic materials or thin web UI. High legibility of Vietnamese accents.
Composition: all six cards have the SAME outer dimensions, same header band height, same hero-art window height, same main benefit band start, same reward-zone height, same button height and same purchase-footer baseline. Strong modular blocks separated by comfortable 12-16px gaps; repeated rounded reward tiles with consistent icon scale, count scale and label style. The reward zone can subdivide differently according to actual content, never invent extra rewards to fill it. Header contains title plus consistently placed red X. Hero is separate from text; never put benefit copy on a busy illustration. Main benefit is a short colored inset strip. Bottom orange button is full-width and very legible. Footer with purchase limit and rates link. Plenty of breathing room, no tiny illegible decoration.
Order and exact contents:
TOP LEFT starter_1: title "Gói Tân binh". Hero smiling boy mechanic with brown hair, goggles, blue/yellow suit as approved reference, gems and tickets on miniature podium. Small yellow badge "4,4× GIÁ TRỊ". Main benefit strip "Sẵn sàng cho lượt đua đầu tiên!". Reward zone 2x2 tiles: "150" / "Gem"; "3" / "Vé Pro"; "3" / "Vé Standard"; "1 giờ" / "Thu nhập". Icons purple gem, red star ticket, blue/yellow gear ticket, green cash with clock respectively. Caveat line "Tiền tính theo thu nhập của đội tại thời điểm mua." Button "$0.99". Footer "Mua 1 lần" and "Xem tỉ lệ".
TOP MIDDLE weekly_s: title "Gói tuần S". Hero same boy with gems, gold star tickets, purple gear tickets. Yellow badge "2,6× GIÁ TRỊ". Main benefit strip "Mỗi tuần một lần.". Same 2x2 reward tiles: "300" / "Gem"; "6" / "Vé All-Star"; "4" / "Vé Elite"; "4 giờ" / "Thu nhập". Caveat "Tiền tính theo thu nhập của đội tại thời điểm mua." Button "$4.99". Footer "1 lần / tuần" and "Xem tỉ lệ".
TOP RIGHT offer_noads_bundle: title "Đội tự do + quà". Hero boy mechanic and a crossed-out advertisement screen, purple gems and gold star ticket, cute tiny racetrack podium. Main benefit strip "Bỏ quảng cáo · Vĩnh viễn". Reward zone: one full-width cream/gold entitlement tile labeled "Bỏ quảng cáo" / "Vĩnh viễn", then two equal reward tiles with "300" / "Gem" and "3" / "Vé All-Star". Caveat "Tắt Ads Break và nhận thẳng thưởng quảng cáo, theo giới hạn từng mục." Button "$9.99". Footer "Mua 1 lần" and "Xem tỉ lệ".
BOTTOM LEFT income_x2: title "Thu nhập ×2". Hero miniature garage with red roof, green cash, gold coins and large blue ×2 medallion. Main benefit strip "Nhân đôi thu nhập, mãi mãi". Reward zone two large equally sized tiles: "×2" / "Thu nhập online"; "×2" / "Thưởng đua", with cash and checkered racing trophy icons. Do NOT show any gem or ticket reward for this product. Caveat two lines "Không áp dụng offline." and "Không cộng dồn boost quảng cáo (lấy mức cao hơn)." Button "$4.99". Footer "Mua 1 lần". Small permanent pill "VĨNH VIỄN" within main benefit block.
BOTTOM MIDDLE no_ads: title "Đội tự do". Hero crossed-out ad screen, blue/gold shield and cute red racing car in approved miniature style. Main benefit strip "Nhận thưởng không cần xem quảng cáo". Reward zone two equally sized tiles: "Bỏ quảng cáo" / "Vĩnh viễn" with crossed-out ad symbol; "100" / "Gem" with purple gem. Caveat "Tắt Ads Break và nhận thẳng thưởng quảng cáo, theo giới hạn từng mục." Button "$9.99". Footer "Mua 1 lần".
BOTTOM RIGHT char_my: title "My về đội bạn". Hero smiling female racer from original reference with brown side braid, red cap with checkered patch and red/white racing suit, thumbs up, cute Soft Miniature figurine. Main benefit strip "Nhận tay đua Zielinski chắc chắn". Reward zone 2x2 tiles: driver portrait / "Zielinski" / "Nhận chắc chắn"; shard portrait / "30 mảnh" / "Zielinski"; "100" / "Gem"; "3" / "Vé Elite". Purple gear ticket for Elite. Button "$4.99". Footer "Mua 1 lần" and "Xem tỉ lệ".
Constraints: preserve ALL prices, quantities, ticket tiers and permanent-perk semantics verbatim. Vietnamese UI. No fictional timers, no forced scarcity, no added discount labels, no extra gifts, no claims of offline income doubling. No duplicate title outside cards. Shared consistent layout is the highest priority: every hero region same height, every price button and footer aligned by row, every panel same padding. Canvas pale warm beige, very subtle shadows; no busy scene outside cards. Final image sharp and clean, full card edges visible.
